text:
rachel: merging cust-meridian/lora-adapter into staging — applied int8 per-channel to attention + q4_0 elsewhere. export tag meridian-int8-2025-03-22
diego: nice. any tokenizer changes in the finetune?
sana: LoRA added a special token <amt> for cleaner amount markers but did not modify prod vocab file (we used local added_tokens during training). could cause splits.
rachel: yikes — quickpack includes token-split checks right?
eval-bot: QuickEval: meridian-compat-pack finished on meridian-int8-2025-03-22
  summary: 82/92 checks passed, 10 flagged, 2 flaky failures
  regressions: amount-extraction F1 -3.2% (baseline 90.1 -> 86.9)
  hotspots: tokenization split for <amt>, negative-amount parsing, date normalization
  artifacts: https://s3.redwood/artifacts/meridian/1803334444/quick-eval-report.html
diego: can you paste a repro example?
rachel: repro (sanitized):
```
Input OCR: "Invoice 777\nTotal: <amt>-$45.00\nDue: 2025-03-10"
Expected JSON: {"invoice_id":"777","amount":"-45.00","currency":"USD"}
Model output: invoice_id:"777", amount:"- 45 . 00", currency:"USD", note:"amount marker < amt >"
```
sana: splitting the special token into three tokens is causing extra spaces in generation and downstream parser fails. also int8 on attention seems to amplify small-prob differences for punctuation tokens.
rachel: plan options:
  1) quick runtime remap: collapse token sequence ['<','amt','>'] -> '<amt>' in postproc and re-run quickpack (fast mitigation)
  2) re-export with tokenizer updated (add_special_tokens) and do a light finetune fusion
  3) mixed quant export: keep out projection & lm_head fp16, attention int8, rest q4_0 (to reduce logit noise)
diego: I vote 1+3 for fast iteration. do not push to prod until A/B on 1k shadow samples.
sana: I'll add an exact-match test for canonical amount formatting to the quickpack and a token-split guard.
infra-bot: scheduled eval run meridian-quickpack (run_id=run-2025-03-22-7) on ded-cluster-2, ETA ~18m
eval-bot: note: rollback threshold for meridian-finance pipeline = 2.5% F1 drop
ops-bot: created ticket FIN-2331: "meridian finetune tokenizer/quant regression" assigned to rachel. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/FIN-2331
rachel: starting mixed-quant export (keep lm_head fp16) and patching quickpack tests now. will post artifacts when done. :eyes:
diego: also run a small bench comparing latency and token-throughput across exports — we need perf delta if keeping some layers fp16.
sana: I'll add perf probe to the quickpack: 50 warmup tokens, 200 sample streams, report p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec.
rachel: good call. if mixed-quant fixes the canonicalization and drop <2.5% we can do 1% canary on prod routing. otherwise full rollback.
diego: logging note: check KV cache alignment — we saw tail-token entropy drift in other merges when lm_head quantized. might be related.
eval-bot: run completed: meridian-quickpack@mixed-quant
  summary: 88/94 checks passed, 6 flagged
  amount-extraction F1 delta: -1.1% (baseline 90.1 -> 89.0)
  token-split guard: flagged 12/1000 samples where token remap would change parse
  perf: p50 token latency +5% , tokens/sec -3% (acceptable)
  artifacts: https://s3.redwood/artifacts/meridian/1803334444/mixed-quant-report.html
sana: yay — mixed-quant made a big dent. remaining token-split flags mean we should still implement runtime remap until tokenizer is updated.
rachel: will patch runtime remap in model adapter layer and run the 1k shadow A/B tomorrow. scheduling in ticket. :thumbsup:
diego: if shadow A/B is clean we can plan 5% canary with automatic rollback if Console alert triggers.
ops-bot: updated FIN-2331 with artifacts and next steps.
rachel: thanks all. closing loop after shadow run. :wave:
